content:
IDC today released a report pointing out that Huawei and Apple were the only manufacturers to record smartphone shipment growth in the Chinese market in the second quarter of 2026. Details are as follows.

The results marked the fifth consecutive quarter of year-on-year decline.

The report showed that Apple recorded the highest year-on-year shipment growth among major smartphone manufacturers in China in the second quarter of 2026, reaching 24.4%.

Driven by this, Apple's ranking jumped from fifth to second place, with its market share rising from 13.9% to 18.1%. Huawei remained the market leader, with its smartphone shipments accounting for 22.6% during the period.

That said, other major smartphone manufacturers all recorded year-on-year declines, with shipments dropping by as much as 60.8%, due to reasons including rising memory and component costs, the withdrawal of government subsidies, and weakening consumer demand, particularly evident during the 618 shopping festival.

Overall, the Chinese smartphone market declined by 4.3% year-on-year, with shipments of approximately 66 million units during the quarter.
